phase_scope: Elapsed windows between first observed durable statuses include polling, control I/O and multiple preparation/restore/installation steps. They are not exact phase, pure restore, or processing-pause timers; unobserved phases remain absent.

consumer_visible_latency.scope: Small deterministic new-pipeline oracle; includes producer creation, sending, cut hold, recovery and consumer observation. Separate from the existing steady-state soak latency sample.

consumer_scope: Nine deterministic new-pipeline oracle observations include producer creation, sending, the deliberate held cut and consumer observation. These do not establish a production latency distribution.

checkpoint_cycle_observation.scope: Harness observations combine finalized predecessor process generations and observed live cuts; state-size floor is disabled and this is not SLO certification.

artifact_endpoint.scope: Read-only final run-namespace endpoint, including persisted orphans; no reachability/deletion authority or growth-rate claim.

unmeasured_scope: The retained harness does not isolate preparing-only consumer latency or pure state restore duration. Input-buffer bytes and managed-state charges are available, rather than queue item counts. Allocation events require an elevated Windows tracing session; the environment check is recorded in performance evidence. Endpoint inventories do not establish a retained-artifact growth rate.
